description: Tiered context escalation: read only packages that match task language. Do not load every doc by default.
content_policy: Repo summaries stay functional/process-only; no people rosters. Secrets stay on Confluence, not in JSON.

tiers.name: session_anchor
tiers.when: Substantive QA or multi-step work; always skim T0 first.
tiers.skip_deep_read_when: Trivial, explicitly local edits (e.g. scratch only under automation/temp/) with no product/QA/process context.

match_any_package.mcp_hint: Confluence: CT home (342168339) for space entry; XT home (402589545) for upstream platform, boards, demo hosts. Strip contacts/people from summaries.
Confluence: QAPORTAL page Corner (497097273) and descendants only—not the whole QA space unless user widens scope.

Structured env URLs, Jira project index, Stash repo ladder, QAPORTAL/CT/XT scope recap—do not invent hosts or branches. Gaps: confluence_search scoped (ancestor=497097273 or space CT/XT) then confluence_get_page; Stash: bitbucket_list_repositories / browse / get_file; bitbucket_search_code may 404 on stash—use epic-prep 5b browse fallback; never copy credentials from Confluence into repo files.
Console-only gate for epic-helper cold start and GROUND preflight. Run crtqa_console_probe.py; recovery /crtqa-console start. No Postgres tunnel in v3 chain.
Internal dxCity CI: Jira comment on CRTQA triggers EPIC-PREP through ANALYSE on Stash team branch. Not in public export. Console OpenSSH: automation/docs/crtqa-console-ci.md. No Jira attach v1.
CLI on PATH (winget jqlang.jq on Windows); not MCP. Project with jq before Read on large repo JSON; canonical filters in automation/docs/jq.md.

dxCore console doctrine: docs/dxcore-console-harness.json (staleness tiers + forks). Surface Confluence IDs only—anchors in JSON confluence_catalog (DXCORE 54134436 narrative; XT 416527013 runtime export hints; DXCORE Home 41877587 hub; QAPORTAL 505946902 onboarding-style tokens; DXCORE Autogenerated 162139511 = archive/low trust—never authoritative). Narrow CQL: type=page AND (space IN (CT, XT, DXCORE) OR ancestor=497097273) plus task terms; fetch confluence_get_page by id—not full-space crawl; Jira issues for pasted operational snippets. Invented syntax forbidden (mcp-atlassian-search). Prefer live host show console_guide after orientation.

dxTrade5 web UI harness: docs/dxtrade5-harness/ (Stage1 concept-map, Stage2 ia-map, Stage3 locations). Truth for layout: live QA host + chrome-devtools (automation/docs/chrome-devtools-mcp.md) over Confluence/Figma. Default QA URL is the app path /webbroker/ on the target host (see docs/corner-platform-map.json application_urls.webbroker — webbroker); do not use retail root URL as base_url in Stage3. Truth for layout: live host + chrome-devtools (automation/docs/chrome-devtools-mcp.md) over Confluence/Figma. Stage3: docs/webbroker-harness/locations/ctqa.json; locations/WAVES.md; parity automation/tools/webbroker-harness/check_locations_parity.py. Confluence hubs same as dxTrade5: CT 342171997, DR 254224494.

All tools in the exposed set are read-only. Stash: project_key+repo_slug from PROJECT_KEY/repo_slug; prefer list/browse/get before bitbucket_search_code; search may 404 while browse works—see docs/mcp-atlassian-tools.md.

match_any_package.note: Open only the ref that matches the deliverable (e.g. test draft norms/schema vs Smart Checklist/coverage vs DR), not necessarily all three.

match_any_package.mcp_hint: Use Figma MCP if enabled in Cursor; paste figma.com links with node-id. Access matches the OAuth user’s file permissions.

automation/tools/yogi-tool/yogi_resolve.py for URL/page_id; yogi_snippet.py (REST + extract) for small snippet_text—avoid pasting full confluence_get_page bodies per tag. --storage-file accepts metadata.content.value (MCP). Extractor disambiguates duplicate keys (DEFINITION vs LINK). --follow --cookie --snippet for one-shot; exit 3 if key missing in storage.

Epic artifact schema v4: obligations_proposed[] per-requirement subprocesses (3c/3d) with downstream_hints; principal reconcile 3i (threads, focus); topology steps 2c/3f-3h; reconcile 6b; epic_prep_verify ref --strict-topology / --strict-principal on new emits. Optional focus=, strict_topology=yes, strict_principal=yes, repo=. No CRTQA or downstream artefacts as input. Yogi snippets; Bitbucket 5b; XT cap ~8. delete EpicDir temp/.

Requires dependencies/<KEY>-ref.json schema v4 with field-level obligations (assertion_fragment). Atomic 1:1 obligation→check; collapsed paste via coverage_md_sync.py (no ## Primary focus). Root <KEY>-coverage.md only. coverage_verify obligations+emit; --strict-topology / --strict-principal. delete EpicDir temp/.
Master index for Round 3 workflow: bounded COVERAGE→GROUND→ANALYSE loop (max 2 rounds), human coverage review, frozen downstream packaging. Calibrate out-of-band.
Requires -coverage.json coverage_pass 1 + -ref.json. Console probes before ANALYSE. Mutates runtime_probes and > detail_lines only.

After TEST-DISCOVER. Merge base -coverage.json; jq slices from -discover.json + helper/affordances-slice.json + operator-feedback.md. coverage_pass 2; coverage_verify --mode reinforce (--strict-principal when principal loaded). No CRTQA.
One pipeline per agent turn; gates env, coverage_review, discover_creds. Scratch epics/<KEY>/helper/ gitignored; archives to context/helper/ on CLOSE. Does not start console from helper.

ANALYSE v2: requires -coverage.json. Work queue from coverage/ref pointers + topology delivery_notes/unresolved oracle + principal deferrals (Round 2 step 3); gaps[] incl deferred_check with obligation_id; exploration_suppressed[] incl deferral_obligation_keyed and delivery blockers; resolve subprocess max 8; known_issues=yes opt-in; strict_principal=yes opt-in. analysis_verify gaps/downstream/emit + --strict-topology / --strict-principal when ref has topology/principal. Gaps-only .md. delete EpicDir temp/.
Linker only after coverage_frozen_at. No Phase 0/browser. discover_verify --mode linker. Live FE → TEST-PRECON. delete EpicDir temp/.
LEGACY — not in draft_truth_v3 chain. Calibrate/benchmark only. delete EpicDir temp/.
draft_truth_v3 scenario_intent default; one bundle per scenario_groups[]; no Phase 0/browser; test_prep_verify --mode scenario_intent. draft_profile=crtqa_outline legacy only. delete EpicDir temp/.

Documentation-only after TEST-PREP. Requires ref, coverage, discover, tests at EpicDir root (precon optional legacy). L0-L4 one subprocess per bundle per level; jq slices. Optional Phase E½ topology lint (strict_topology=yes) and Phase E¾ principal lint (strict_principal=yes); close_verify.py --mode topology / --mode principal. Finalize whitelist corrections; regenerate three root md; archive always to context/ including -close.json. close_verify.py + close_archive.py. No MCP.
Read docs/harness-principles.md for production-only generation, CRTQA non-reliance, coverage vs E2E, operator gold under .cursor/calibrate/.

gold_gate + gold_distinct (hard stop if gold copies prod) + compare. NO_ACTIONABLE_DELTA = success, no harness suggestions. DELTA_REVIEW only then playbook 6.6 (max 3 lessons, diff_evidence required). calibrate_verify.py --self-test.

Paste-deploy Expr snippets only; live Structure board 603 is source of truth. Roadmap columns: automation/structure/roadmap-columns/metadata.json. QA Est: automation/structure/qa-est/metadata.json (draft customfield_11250 vs remaining). Do not invent formulas.
Harness hygiene only: corner-harness-verify.ps1 profiles, sessionStart inject, not epic pipeline verifiers.

CLOSE: does not use MCP. Legacy Postgres MCP: automation/archive/legacy-ctqa-env/ (not in v3 pipeline). For live UI during legacy exploration, configure chrome-devtools per automation/docs/chrome-devtools-mcp.md.
tiers.mcp_scope: Scope Atlassian searches using docs/project.json, docs/qa-project.json, and docs/corner-platform-map.json mcp_scope_recap (CT, XT, QAPORTAL subtree rooted at 497097273).

rules: Do not read all JSON and ref files for every task. Match the user's language to T1 match_any_package entries; when one package is the clear best fit, read primarily its read[] list.

If the user message names a Jira issue key in Corner families (CRT, CRTQA, CRTBL, XT, SUPXT, CAN), use user-mcp-atlassian (jira_get_issue or jira_search) to fetch it before substantive ticket-specific prose—do not invent fields or comments.

When multiple T1 packages could apply, also read docs/corner-platform-map.json if the task involves where to reproduce (environment, hostname, database name, WebBroker vs dxTrade5 vs Adaptive), which Jira project or dashboard, or which Stash repo—unless scope is unrelated (e.g. Figma-only).
After T1, use MCP for authoritative Atlassian content; do not invent ticket or page text.

For **dxCore console operations** (scripted or interactive **`dx run console`** style work, multiplex/crtqa-console tooling, **`console_guide`** discovery on hosts), prefer T1 package **dxcore_console** (`docs/dxcore-console-harness.json` + crtqa-console README) over **`corner_platform_map`** unless the task is primarily environments/Stash/jira-index infra without console command work.

For **dxTrade5** (or related **web trading UI**) **screen maps**, **widget discoverability**, and **browser-led** exploration (Chrome DevTools MCP during discover/precon/prep), prefer T1 package **dxtrade5_harness** (`docs/dxtrade5-harness/`) over **`corner_platform_map`** alone unless the task is only hostnames/repos/env index without UI navigation.

For **dealer WebBroker** (`/webbroker/` app path) **screen maps**, **Order Book**, and **embedded dxTrade-class widgets**, prefer T1 package **webbroker_harness** (`docs/webbroker-harness/`) over **dxtrade5_harness** when the task is explicitly WebBroker/dealer shell—not retail Cornèrtrader root.
Never copy passwords or secrets from Confluence into repo files.
When adding new durable docs or paths, update AGENTS.md, README.md, and this map per harness-maintenance rule.
EpicDir for pipeline triggers is always epics/<KEY>/ (production). Post-hoc prod vs gold: /epic-calibrate and docs/calibrate-contract.json — do not mix gold into generation runs.
